source_manifest_hash_policy: SHA256 of source bytes normalized CRLF to LF; excludes private data and receipts.

local_python_targeted.command: .venv/Scripts/python.exe -m pytest -q tests/test_human_knowledge.py tests/test_human_knowledge_runtime.py tests/test_human_knowledge_cli.py tests/test_source_provenance.py tests/test_source_legacy_cycle.py tests/test_context_packing.py tests/test_reference_contracts.py tests/test_export_availability.py tests/test_p101_runtime_costs.py --junitxml=.local/p1-02-human-knowledge/pytest-targeted.xml

local_node.command: node --check app/static/{app,editorial,planning,publishing,transcription}.js (five separate commands); node --test tests/frontend_export.test.cjs tests/frontend_sources.test.cjs tests/frontend_consistency.test.cjs tests/frontend_costs.test.cjs

ci.required: Full Python suite, Node tests/syntax and Docker on delivery code SHA.
